official_definition: This Spirit can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you do, this Spirit doesn't exhaust. By sending two cores from any of your "Rekka Yukimura" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, instead, this Spirit attacks without exhausting.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Infinite Unleash] or [Infinite Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Infinite Unleash]", "give [Infinite Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Enables direct targeting of opposing Spirit/Ultimate during attack step.
